name: ai-for-all
description: AI Coding Assistant - Better than OpenCode

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../ai-service && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
